tools.name: get_readiness_questions
tools.description: Returns the self-assessment questions on AI readiness in four areas (data, processes, people, compliance), each with its id, the reason it is asked and the allowed answer options. Answers are option ids, not free text.

tools.name: assess_ai_readiness
tools.description: Scores the answers from get_readiness_questions with fixed rules: a level from 0 to 4 per area, the rule behind each limit, the gaps found and a next step for each gap. Unanswered areas are reported as not assessed. The result is a self-assessment.

tools.name: estimate_ai_costs
tools.description: Estimates the costs of introducing AI, shown separately as external costs (contractor, DPIA, legal review, AI literacy training), internal staff time, licences per month and operations per month (hosting, model usage, maintenance), and the payback period in three savings scenarios. tools.name: plan_ai_rollout
tools.description: Returns a phased rollout plan (discovery, pilot, rollout, operations) with tasks, roles in RACI form, risks and indicators for the chosen implementation pattern. When readiness answers are given, preparation tasks for areas at level 0 or 1 are added to the discovery phase.

tools.name: adoption_list_process_types
tools.description: Returns the six process types of the knowledge base (data capture, communication, documents, planning, control, knowledge) with a definition and the ids of the adoption patterns of each type.

tools.name: adoption_find_patterns
tools.description: Advises on using AI in a process the user describes, from a curated knowledge base with sources. The caller passes the description, the task that best matches it and the process properties it states; the server selects deterministically and does not use a language model. tools.name: adoption_get_regulations
tools.description: Returns the EU and national provisions in the regulation register for the chosen country, optionally only those linked to one pattern, each with what it requires in plain words, the article, the date checked and a link to the official text.
